title: Alcaraz Defeats Safiullin in US Open Return After Four-Month Layoff
dek: Defending US Open champion Carlos Alcaraz returned from a four-month injury absence and defeated Roman Safiullin of Russia 6-4, 6-4, 6-4 in the first round on September 1. The decisive victory advanced Alcaraz to the second round of the tournament he won in 2025.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Alcaraz, the defending US Open champion, defeated Safiullin 6-4, 6-4, 6-4 in his first competitive match after a four-month injury layoff, per BBC Sport.
bottom_line: Alcaraz's progression through the draw will reveal whether the opening-round dominance reflects durable fitness or a match-by-match recovery from injury.
body: Carlos Alcaraz, the defending US Open champion, advanced to the second round with a 6-4, 6-4, 6-4 victory over Roman Safiullin of Russia on September 1. The match marked Alcaraz's first competitive outing after a four-month injury absence, according to BBC Sport reporting.
The decisive straight-set result provided an early signal of Alcaraz's readiness following his extended layoff from competition.
